_comment: 5.2.0 negative path, independent of the positive script. A message with an empty bodies list cannot be created: the ChatMessage constructor throws ChatError(-1, 'A message requires at least one body.') before anything reaches native, so nothing is sent. -1 is also the fallback code of the script runner (unknown API, non-ChatError exceptions), so confirm in the log that the description is the one above. No invented error code for the native body-count limit (20) or body-type combinations: the real codes depend on the native SDK and have not been observed on a device.
